findings.why: No EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result for heat H-4471 is in the documents. The control plan requires a certificate review for each lot before release to production. It also requires an Rp0.2 test (SC-01, at least 250 MPa) for each heat. Someone must confirm that the certificate shows EN AW-6082-T6 and a yield of at least 250 MPa. Supplier approval AP-0311 (BR-220, TO1, STL, Alluminio B, Rev C) is current, so no source-release finding applies.
